thread:
Zoe (Finance Ops): TokenSage sent a renewal quote mixing commit + seat bundles + a variable overage. Can procurement/eng/legal quick-check?
Mark (Procurement): On it. Primary asks: itemized SKUs, annual prepay vs monthly commit math, migration credits, cancellation and refund policy.
Tori (Platform): Usage snapshot: 3mo avg 510M tokens/mo, 95th ~790M. Two heavy routes: /api/chat and /api/embed. Need per-key attribution and webhook sample to validate our importer.
Evan (TokenSage Sales): TL;DR: tiers: TS_COMMIT_400=$2,400/mo, TS_COMMIT_800=$4,200/mo, TS_COMMIT_1.5B=$7,800/mo. Seats: SEAT_10=$900/mo. PAYG $0.007/1k tokens. Migration credit: up to 17% of first-year committed spend on 12mo commits, applied evenly across first 12 invoices. Annual prepay gets 8% off. Overage billed at PAYG by default; discounted overage (12% off) available when monthly usage <120% of commit.
Evan (TokenSage Sales): Webhook sample (metadata only):
POST /hooks/usage
{ "customer_id":"rw-4310", "ts":"2025-12-08T11:05:02Z", "tokens":1320, "route":"/api/chat", "api_key":"prod-8", "req_id":"req_x9" }
Tori (Platform): Will need sku_hint or tenant_tag to map to our product lines. Also request monthly CSV export (signed link) for reconciliation.
Evan (TokenSage Sales): We support tenant_tag + optional sku_hint for enterprise. Monthly CSV export available at /billing/exports?month=YYYY-MM.
Sam (Legal): Legal needs data retention for raw payloads, purge-on-termination, DPA, subprocessor list, and explicit 30-day non-auto-renew language. Termination penalty caps please.
Evan (TokenSage Sales): Default raw retention 60 days; billing metadata 7 years. Can add purge-on-termination and include DPA + SOC2 report. We'll include 30-day non-auto-renew in enterprise addendum; termination refunds limited per contract.
Zoe (Finance Ops): If we take TS_COMMIT_800 it approx matches our 95th and likely saves ~1.5k/mo vs PAYG. Mark  can you run a 3yr TCO comparing monthly commit vs annual prepay vs commit+seats?
Mark (Procurement): Will run TCO and share spreadsheet. Can we schedule a 30m sync with TokenSage next Tue 10am PT? Evan confirm?
Evan (TokenSage Sales): Tue 10am PT works. I'll upload an itemized SKU sheet, sample invoice (Net30), DPA, webhook schema, and CSV spec by EOD Friday.
Zoe (Finance Ops): Thanks all  close loop once we have the formal quote and PO template.
